new_product_ideas.name: Floating Wall Shelf with Hidden Hardware
new_product_ideas.notes: Minimalist floating shelves with concealed mounting bracket. Print in neutral PLA+, use PETG for heavier load versions. Trending in home organization niche.

new_product_ideas.name: Propagation Station / Plant Vase Set
new_product_ideas.notes: Modular vase sets for plant cuttings. PETG handles water contact. Top-selling 3D print category on Etsy. Boho and minimalist variants both sell well.

new_product_ideas.name: Bathroom Organizer Set (toothbrush holder, soap dish, cup)
new_product_ideas.notes: Matching 3-piece bathroom set. PETG required for moisture and soap resistance. Bundle pricing drives higher AOV.

new_product_ideas.name: Entryway Key & Mail Organizer
new_product_ideas.notes: Wall-mounted with hooks and a small tray. Practical gift item. Personalizable with initials or house number.

new_product_ideas.name: Hexagonal Wall Planter Set
new_product_ideas.notes: Geometric hexagon wall-mounted planters. Silk PLA for display/no-plant use, PETG if holding soil. Group of 3 or 6 arrangement photos drive conversions.

new_product_ideas.name: Coaster Set with Holder (4-pack)
new_product_ideas.notes: Heat-resistant coasters with a matching vertical holder. PETG or ABS for heat tolerance. Geometric or boho patterns. Great gift item.

new_product_ideas.name: MagSafe Desk Dock / Phone Stand
new_product_ideas.notes: Desk dock that holds iPhone at 45-degree angle, compatible with MagSafe charger. Tech/productivity niche. Silk PLA for premium look.

new_product_ideas.name: Wall-Mounted Spice Rack
new_product_ideas.notes: Modular wall spice rack, holds standard spice jars. PETG for food-adjacent use. Modular design = buyers purchase multiple units.

new_product_ideas.name: Decorative Bookends (animal or geometric)
new_product_ideas.notes: Weighted bookends with kawaii animal or geometric designs. Silk PLA for premium metallic finish. Kawaii cat or bear designs align with shop aesthetic.

new_product_ideas.name: Cable Management Clips (desk organizer set)
new_product_ideas.notes: Desk cable clips and cord organizers. TPU for flexibility, PLA for rigidity. Low material cost, fast print time = high margin. Productivity/WFH niche.
